$schema_note: Acknowledged `supabase migration repair` placeholder rows, per target. Read by scripts/migration-rehearsal/check-migration-safety.mjs. A placeholder row is one with statements IS NULL: it asserts a version is applied without recording what content was applied, so history stops being proof of what is live. Listing a VERSION here means a human already reconciled that version against the live schema and accepts it as baseline noise. Contents are deliberately NOT recorded -- a placeholder has none. Adding entries must be a reviewed commit, never a runtime flag, so an automated loop cannot acknowledge the very row that should have stopped it.
$how_to_extend: Run the gate. If it refuses with E21 it prints a paste-ready array containing the existing baseline plus the new versions. Confirm each new version against the live schema first (e.g. pg_get_functiondef on the objects that migration touches), then paste, set acknowledged_at, and commit.
